name: Fate of One
body:
Discipline Clairsentience; Level Seer 7

MANIFESTING

Display Mental and visual
Manifesting Time 1 immediate action

EFFECT

Range Personal
Target You
Duration Instantaneous
Power Points 13

DESCRIPTION

Your limited omniscience allows you to reroll a saving throw, attack roll, or skill check. Whatever the result of the reroll, you must use it even if it is worse than the original roll.

If you use the power to reroll a saving throw, you can manifest this power even when it is not your turn.
